summary: Frontend-only static + preview verification of the advisory 'Run AI Production Review' panel in JobView. Preview URL loads successfully to the first-admin setup screen (empty production, first-run), as expected. Per request constraints, no authentication, admin creation, data mutation, or AI call was performed. Source inspection of /app/frontend/src/App.js JobView confirms all four acceptance criteria.

static_verification.request_body: NONE (api called with { method: 'POST' } only; no browser-supplied state)
static_verification.result_rendering: Renders agent · status (STOP/WARN/PASS), summary paragraph, and 'Next:' line for stop_reasons / warnings. Heading toggles 'Not production-ready' when any STOP else 'Production review complete'.
static_verification.unavailable_provider_label: 'Rule-based review' shown in panel header and results when settings?.aiConnected is falsy; 'AI-assisted' when true.
static_verification.runAgentReview_source_audit: Function only calls api(POST /agents/evaluate) then setAgentReview(review) and reload() (GET). No calls to act(), process(), upload(), control(), approvals, or print mutations. Confirms advisory-only semantics.
static_verification.preview_load: https://p2g-production.preview.emergentagent.com loads to 'Set up your shop' first-admin setup — expected on empty first-run production.

critical_code_review_comments: The entire JobView <section data-testid="production-review-panel"> is written as a single long JSX line (line 352). It is functionally correct but reduces readability/diff-review quality; consider formatting across multiple lines.
runAgentReview catches errors into setError but surfaces reason.message only; if backend returns FastAPI {detail: ...}, ensure api() helper normalizes to .message. Minor DX note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prior iterations (iteration_10.json) covered broader agents e2e. This iteration is a narrow preview shell verification of the advisory production-review panel per restricted scope (no admin create, no AI call). All four acceptance criteria pass by static inspection; preview URL loads to empty-first-run setup page as expected. Full dynamic flow would require creating admin + a job before clicking the Run button; main agent can self-test if needed.
